name: EIA Open Data API v2
rate_limits: Up to 5,000 rows per JSON request. Callers must throttle per second and per hour or the key is suspended for a while; exact numbers are not published (source: https://www.eia.gov/opendata/documentation.php).
history_start: Varies; WTI spot from 1986, Henry Hub from 1997.
what_it_has: Oil and gas spot prices, weekly crude and gas inventories, production, the Short Term Energy Outlook and international energy data.
simple: The US government office that tracks oil and gas, including how much is stored each week.
license_terms: US government data is public domain. EIA asks for a source line with the publication date. https://www.eia.gov/about/copyrights_reuse.php
quality_notes: Without a key the API answers API_KEY_MISSING (tested). Weekly inventory numbers can be revised later and the API shows the latest values. WTI was negative on 2020-04-20.

relevance.reason: Weekly oil and gas inventory releases are the commodity news most likely to move CAD and NOK.

news_use.what_we_store: headline, link and a summary of at most 280 characters
news_use.terms_quote: public domain; cite EIA with the date
